messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Carol Tan <carol.tan@acme.com>, Acme ML Platform <ml-platform@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings handoff: prioritized index repop & rerank smoke harness (timeline + gating)

Carol / Acme ML team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is a concise first-pass plan for the embeddings + rerank handoff focused on minimizing user impact during repopulation. High-level asks below; detailed tasks are in the attached PDF (acme-priority-index-plan-v1.pdf).

Top asks for you to prioritize this week:
- Confirm the three highest-priority content buckets (product docs, support KB, order history) — we need a single CSV sample per bucket by Wed Jun 23.
- Confirm whether VectorStoreX will be the canonical store for live traffic or if you want us to run a temporary shadow store during backfill.
- Share the acceptance criteria for rerank quality (target NDCG/precision thresholds) or let us use the attached sample eval set as the baseline.

Planned timeline (working):
- Wed Jun 23: Receive samples + dataset owner for each bucket.
- Fri Jun 25: Smoke harness run on 1k samples + rerank eval (internal).
- Mon Jun 28: Canary backfill started (staggered windows).

Attachments: acme-priority-index-plan-v1.pdf, acme-eval-sample-300.csv

I'll coordinate internal checkpoints — Monica will lead the backfill ops and Ben will shadow rerank metrics during smoke runs. Aditya will coordinate billing/commit questions.

If the times above look good, can we lock in a 30-min sync for Thu Jun 24 at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0127
From: Carol Tan <carol.tan@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme ML Platform <ml-platform@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings handoff: prioritized index repop & rerank smoke harness (timeline + gating)

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear plan. We're good to proceed with the three buckets you listed. Quick notes:
- Samples: we'll export representative slices for product docs and support KB today; order history will need a data-access SLA to be approved — expect that by Thu morning.
- VectorStore: we're standardizing on VectorStoreX for production; however, we prefer Redwood to run the backfill into a shadow namespace first so we can validate results without touching our live indexes.
- Rerank metrics: we'll aim for a top-10 NDCG delta <= 0.02 compared to baseline (current sparse results). The attached eval sample looks fine as a starting point — we'll add 200 labeled pairs next week.

Thurs 10am PT works for our team. Inviting my data-owner (ml-platform@acme.com) to the sync.

Best,
Carol Tan
Head of Search & Discovery, Acme Retail
carol.tan@acme.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Carol Tan <carol.tan@acme.com>, Acme ML Platform <ml-platform@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings handoff: prioritized index repop & rerank smoke harness (timeline + gating)

Thanks Carol — that's helpful. Short updates before the Thursday sync:

1) Shadow namespace: fine — Monica, please provision a shadow namespace in VectorStoreX and share credentials with Acme's ml-platform only (do not put in shared drive).
2) Samples: Carol, if we get the two public buckets today, our team will sample and return a sanitized 1k set for the smoke harness by Thu morning. If order-history SLA lags, we can proceed with the first two buckets only.
3) Acceptance automation: Ben, can you confirm we can run the NDCG comparison in the rerank harness and surface a delta report to the shared Drive link? Link below.

Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/acme/embeddings/onboarding-plan

Agenda for Thu 10am PT (30 min):
- 5m: rollcall + scope confirmation
- 10m: backfill window & shadow namespace ops
- 10m: rerank smoke harness success criteria + dashboards
- 5m: next steps & owners

I'll send calendar invite.

—Stephanie
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Carol Tan <carol.tan@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings handoff: prioritized index repop & rerank smoke harness (timeline + gating)

All —

Quick technical checklist for the Thursday run (so you can prep):
- VectorStoreX namespace name + write key (Acme to provide)
- Schema mapping: we need a single id field, text (utf8), metadata blob with at least {doc_type, created_at, source}. If you have additional fields (language, product_id), include them but we won't rely on them for the smoke run.
- Embedding model config: We'll use the Redwood-embed-v2 baseline unless you request a different model; please confirm by Wed EOD.
- Backfill cadence: We'll do staggered windows of 30m for initial canary (max insertion rate 1k/min) and monitor CPU/KV cache pressure.
- Safety: For order-history records, redact PII before ingestion; if you need help we can run a redaction pass — let us know.

Attachments referenced: rerank-smoke-harness.zip (contains harness scripts and a README). I added brief run commands in the README. If VectorStoreX support is needed, I've CC'd their support alias.

Monica Patel
Senior Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
